@here Guess What? It’s time for a quick scavenger hunt!! FIND FARMER JOE!

In the last video we posted “The Domes - Building Tools for All”, there are actually 4 Farmer Joe’s hidden in the last scene before fading to black. Our game devs thought it would be fun to add these in for the community to find!

Here’s how it will work… 

The community will have 24 hours to locate each Farmer Joe (4 of them). Once you have located each Joe, I would recommend taking a screenshot of the video in full screen mode and then draw a circle around each Farmer Joe. You will then take your image and upload to our JotForm linked below. 

At the end of the 24hr period I will close the hunt and will tally up all the correct answers and will submit into a drawing. We will have 3 winners that will each receive a village house!

Rules:

- You may only submit an answer once, so triple check your answers before submitting. NON NEGOTIABLE!
- If you post your answers publicly, you will be disqualified and kicked from the server for 72hrs. 
- You are free to discuss answers privately (DM) with your friends, but this will obviously decrease your chances of winning. 
- Circles must be clear, and concise. If you draw a massive circle hoping it has farmer joe in it, you will be disqualified.
- Discord names must be submitted with image upload (including # at the end of name)

Helpful hints/tools:

- View the video in 4k resolution via the settings menu on YouTube.
- There is a second “Abigail” character that is hidden as well so make sure you don’t circle her instead of Joe!
- You can use this tool to draw your circles if you don’t have photoshop or another program: https://www9.lunapic.com/editor/?action=draw
- 3 of the Farmer Joes are somewhat easy to find. One of him is rather difficult.

YOUTUBE VIDEO: https://youtu.be/lwenZo0l9NY (edited)

Hello all, 

As you may know the Cardano infrastructure is still early and as a result lacking a few needed services (dex, multisig wallet, vesting and unlocking protocols).  We still love Cardano and in fact will be launching our public land sale soon, those NFTs will be minted on Cardano.  Our token will primarily reside on BSC. (however- we will mint on ERC20 and when the Cardano ecosystem matures next year, we will be able to use the ERC20 converter to port over the same way other Cardano projects are planning).

We will be announcing which launch pads tomorrow.  Strategically this is the right long term play for us as we need some of the smart contracts support they are providing in addition to the marketing to provide an incredibly strong user base for the game.  Tokens will be sold through the IDO platforms at the same price as private round.  This is very rarely done so I hope you can appreciate it! 

Finally, we will have a public land sale that is available for all (US residents also) as soon as our tech is ready!  Keep your eyes peeled for an amazing new game play video later this week!

Thank You!

@everyone

I apologize for the confusing statement regarding BSC and ERC-20. To clarify.....

We will be launching our token on ERC20 and immediately bridge it over to BSC so that you do NOT have to deal with gas fees. The reason we are doing this is because it is much easier to reverse back to Cardano once the Cardano ecosystem is ready. 

Again... token will live on BSC and you will not have to deal with ETH gas fees. 

Thanks everyone! (edited)
